info.title: Rodrigo service contract
info.description: Backward-compatible signed Hub-to-Rodrigo contract. V2 typed action families are independently committed in PostgreSQL with workspace-scoped idempotency receipts. Collection pages are bounded, keyset ordered by resourceId, and each page reflects one database statement snapshot; later pages are not a frozen multi-page snapshot. Workspace comes exclusively from verified Ed25519 assertions. Anonymous Site reads use a reserved Hub service assertion and a slug index; the browser cannot select the workspace. Blob bytes and external side effects require separate contracts. Platform administration (platform contract version 1) is owned by Rodrigo in PostgreSQL under the reserved assertion workspace rodrigo-platform: compare-and-swap configuration with changeId idempotency, a revision row and an audit row committed atomically per change, rollback as a new revision, applied-version reports from service:hub and service:ocr-worker, and an append-only audit trail. Hub-owned audit appends are not atomic with Hub state. Namespace values are non-secret by contract.

get.description: Read current resource and revision. Revisions order mutations for one workspace/app/type/resource id; deleted or absent resources return resource null with revision 0 for never-present rows or the last tombstone revision.

400.description: Invalid resource identity

403.description: Missing app/resource read scope

post.description: At most 100 independently committed actions. The HTTP body is bounded to 256 KiB. A parse, authentication, or scope failure commits none. Provider failures return per-action rejected results; retry with the same actionId and identical action. Results may be returned in any order and are correlated by actionId. Receipts are retained at least ten years and currently are not pruned. Resource revisions are ordered within workspace/app/resource identity.

200.description: One result per action; committed and duplicate are durable acknowledgements

400.description: Invalid or oversized batch

403.description: Missing app or action scope

413.description: Body exceeds 256 KiB

429.description: Admission limit

504.description: Request deadline; retry identical actions

200.description: HTTP ready; dataReady covers configured v1 document ownership and actionReady reports the v2 PostgreSQL action writer independently

get.description: Cursor is signed in the path. Last-Event-ID headers are rejected. SSE event document.changed has ID equal to revision and ChangeEvent JSON data. 1000 revisions retained per workspace/kind; pages of 64; max 32 streams per replica. Stream closes within assertion lifetime, at most 25 seconds; Hub reauthorizes and re-signs reconnects. At-least-once replay within retention, no server-side acknowledgements. stream.error with cursor_expired or dependency_unavailable terminates an already-open stream. No cross-kind ordering.

schema.description: Use latest for the newest page; otherwise an RFC3339 timestamp, pipe, and resourceId from the previous page.

get.description: Returns a stable channel timeline ordered by createdAt then resourceId. Newest-page and older/newer cursor reads are bounded. Rodrigo derives message author identity from the verified assertion and returns createdByUserId separately from client payload. Private/direct channels require the asserted actor in the channel's server-validated memberIds. Each request is statement-consistent; pages are not frozen across requests.

400.description: Invalid channel, direction, limit, or cursor

403.description: Missing read scope or channel membership

404.description: Channel not found

get.description: Returns one published Site page and, when a shop block is present, active USD product cards. The assertion workspace must be the reserved public-site grant and the actor must be the public reader. The slug selects the page; it does not select a workspace. Unpublished and unknown slugs are not_found. The response omits workspace id, actor id, and draft fields.

400.description: Slug is not a public path segment

403.description: Assertion is not the reserved public-site grant or is missing read scopes

404.description: Slug is unknown or the page is not published

get.description: Returns one published form definition. The assertion must be the reserved public grant with app:forms and read:forms.form. The slug selects the form; it does not select a workspace. Unpublished, deleted and unknown slugs are not_found. The response omits workspace id and actor id.

400.description: Slug is not a public path segment

403.description: Assertion is not the reserved public grant or is missing form scopes

404.description: Slug is unknown or the form is not published

post.description: Stores one anonymous submission for a published form that is accepting responses. Requires the reserved public grant with app:forms and action:forms.submission.create. Rodrigo resolves the workspace and form from the slug, validates answers against the stored definition in the same transaction, and records the server time. submissionId is the idempotency key: the same id with the same answers returns duplicate; with different answers it is refused.

400.description: Slug or body is malformed

403.description: Assertion is not the reserved public grant or is missing form scopes

404.description: Slug is unknown or the form is not published

409.description: form_closed, or submission_id_reused with different answers

get.description: Returns non-deleted resources for one workspace/app/resourceType, ordered by resourceId ascending. Cursor is the hex-encoded last resourceId. Each page is one statement-consistent read; pages are not pinned to a shared snapshot, so concurrent inserts/deletes may affect later pages. Item revisions are authoritative per resource and clients must reconcile/re-read on revision changes.

400.description: Invalid app/resourceType/limit/cursor

403.description: Missing app or resource read scope

get.description: Current configuration snapshot. Any actor. Requires an assertion with workspaceId "rodrigo-platform" (PLATFORM_WORKSPACE_ID); that reserved workspace is rejected on every non-platform route and every other workspace (including the reserved public-site grant) is rejected here, both with 403 platform_grant_route_mismatch.

put.description: Compare-and-swap configuration write. sub must be a platform administrator verified by Hub, not service:* (403 platform_actor_forbidden). The config row, revision row and config.update audit row commit in one PostgreSQL transaction. A stale expectedRevision rolls back, appends a best-effort conflict audit row and returns 409 revision_conflict. Validation order: actor, namespace, body, provider. Requires an assertion with workspaceId "rodrigo-platform" (PLATFORM_WORKSPACE_ID); that reserved workspace is rejected on every non-platform route and every other workspace (including the reserved public-site grant) is rejected here, both with 403 platform_grant_route_mismatch.

hubAssertion.description: iss=sorye-hub, aud=rodrigo, sub, workspaceId, scope, method, path, bodySha256, iat, exp <= iat+30, jti UUID. v2 additionally requires appScopes and actionScopes for action batches. kid selects trusted public key. TLS required across VMs. Assertions are bearer credentials until expiration; jti is not a distributed replay lock.

expectedRevision.description: Required for update/delete; omitted for create. Prevents silent stale overwrites.

resource.description: Typed domain payload or null if missing/deleted.

createdByUserId.description: Identity derived from the verified action assertion; never copied from request payload.

driveFileId.description: Legacy single Hub Drive file id for a Tasks-section image. Rodrigo stores this id only; the bytes stay in Hub Drive. New tickets use attachmentIds. A task must not include both fields.

attachmentIds.description: Hub Drive file ids for images in the Tasks section. Rodrigo stores these ids only; the bytes stay in Hub Drive. Omit when the ticket has no images. Do not send this together with driveFileId.

driveFileId.description: Legacy single Hub Drive file id for a Tasks-section image. Rodrigo stores this id only; the bytes stay in Hub Drive. New tickets use attachmentIds. A task must not include both fields.

attachmentIds.description: Hub Drive file ids for images in the Tasks section. Rodrigo stores these ids only; the bytes stay in Hub Drive. Omit when the ticket has no images. Do not send this together with driveFileId.

code.description: provider_unavailable is retryable with the identical actionId and payload; other codes require user correction or reconciliation

memberIds.description: Required for direct/private channels; direct channels have exactly two members and the verified actor must be included.

options.description: Required for select and multiselect; not allowed on other kinds.

FormSubmissionPayload.description: Created only by the public submission route. A member update may change status only.

status.description: Create accepts only requested. Updates may use the full enum and remain limited to the verified creating actor.

note.description: Customer enquiry text. Actor ownership is createdByUserId from the verified assertion, not a payload field.

createdByUserId.description: Identity derived from the verified action assertion.

nextCursor.description: Hex-encoded final resourceId when another page exists.

SharedAiConfigV1.description: shared-ai schemaVersion 1. Namespace values are non-secret by contract: no password, token, key or connection string may ever be added. Rodrigo never fetches baseUrl; consumers apply their own host allowlist.

baseUrl.description: Empty means unconfigured. Otherwise an absolute http or https URL with a host and no username, password, query, fragment, whitespace or control characters.

model.description: Empty means unconfigured. Must not contain "..".

PlatformConfigSnapshot.description: Never-written namespaces return revision 0 and null value/updatedAt/updatedBy.

changeId.description: Idempotency key. Same changeId and identical request returns status duplicate with the original revision and auditId; a different request returns 409 idempotency_key_reused.

expectedRevision.description: 0 creates only; otherwise must equal the current revision (compare-and-swap). Never last-writer-wins.

reason.description: Optional administrator note; at most 240 characters, no control characters. Never put secrets here.

PlatformConfigRollback.description: Writes the stored value of targetRevision as a NEW revision. History is never deleted or rewritten. targetRevision must be lower than expectedRevision (else 400 invalid_rollback).

reason.description: Optional administrator note; at most 240 characters, no control characters. Never put secrets here.

PlatformAppliedReport.description: Assertion sub must be exactly service:hub or service:ocr-worker and consumer must equal sub without the service: prefix (else 403 platform_actor_forbidden).

appliedRevision.description: Greater than the current revision returns 400 unknown_revision.

consumers.description: Reports from the last 24 hours, newest first. Rows older than seven days are pruned when any consumer reports.

PlatformAuditAppend.description: Hub-owned administrative actions whose state is not in Rodrigo (for example plan assignment and notices kept in Hub). NOT atomic with that Hub state: Hub must append pending/succeeded/failed rows around its own commit and reconcile on unknown outcomes.

eventId.description: Becomes auditId. Replays with an identical request return duplicate; a different request returns 409 idempotency_key_reused.

action.description: Actions starting with config. are reserved for Rodrigo (400 reserved_action).

details.description: Flat, non-secret values only: strings (at most 240 characters, no control characters), numbers, booleans or null. No nested objects or arrays.
config.update/config.rollback: {before, after, reason[, rolledBackTo]}; conflicts: {expectedRevision, reason}; otherwise the Hub-supplied details.

nextCursor.description: Hex-encoded UTF-8 "<occurredAt>|<auditId>" of the last event when another page exists.
